correctness.rationale: All 512 binary 3-by-3 arrays and all nine row-column deletion choices are exhaustively evaluated from the definition. Two independent deletion implementations agree. Exact set packing over the 16 possible outputs proves the maximum is 4; a witness attains 4. Exhaustive four-clique enumeration gives 514 optima, and a verified 16-element channel-symmetry action partitions them into 46 classes.

value.rationale: The result is a natural complete classification at the smallest square size whose deletion outputs retain two-dimensional 2-by-2 structure. It gives an exact benchmark for a modern synchronization-error model and shows that extremizers have 46 inequivalent channel-symmetry types rather than a unique template.
